dossier.summary: Brookside Electric is a residential electrical contractor with about 12 electricians, run by its owner.

catalog.clues: Careers pages that ask for Routeboard experience; a Book online page that loads the Routeboard widget; HVAC and plumbing companies with 50 or more technicians
catalog.us: One board per day with crews as rows. Drag a job to a crew and the technician's phone updates on the spot.
catalog.them: A list-style board with a map view. Moving a job means editing it, and the technician sees it on the next sync.
catalog.note: Matters most when the day changes after 8 am.

catalog.us: Works without signal. Checklists, photos and the customer's signature sync when the phone is back online.
catalog.them: Needs a connection for job details and photos, which bites in basements and rural areas.
catalog.note: Ask your technicians how often the app spins.

catalog.us: A booking page with your services and time windows. No branded widget for your own site yet.
catalog.them: A booking widget that sits on your site and shows live availability. Customers already know it.
catalog.note: If most jobs come in through your website, this row counts double.

catalog.us: Invoice from the job, card on file, deposit links.
catalog.them: Invoice from the job, card on file, financing offers built in.

catalog.us: Twelve standard reports and a CSV export for anything else.
catalog.them: A report builder you shape yourself, plus a dashboard per branch.
catalog.note: A plus if someone on your team lives in reports.

catalog.us: Two-way sync with the common accounting tools. Invoices and payments post the same day.
catalog.them: One-way export, run by hand, with a reconcile step at month end.

catalog.us: We import customers, equipment and open jobs from your export. Most teams of your size run live within two weeks.
catalog.them: A guided setup over six to eight weeks with a dedicated onboarding manager.
catalog.note: Routeboard's longer setup also covers more custom work.

site.title: Brookside Electric
site.description: Licensed residential electricians. Panels, rewires, EV chargers.
site.markdown:
# Brookside Electric

Licensed residential electricians. Panel upgrades, rewires, EV chargers, lighting.

## Request service

Call the office between 7 and 4, weekdays. For emergencies after hours, call and leave a message.

## About

Family owned since 2008. Twelve electricians, all licensed.
